notes.title: Local co-op mode released!
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Gregory Horror Show Soul of Roses.

We have implemented a local co-op mode in the update!
James is the new control character and you can explore with your friends.
You can also play with friends online using the Steam Remote Play Together feature.
When you start a new run, the co-op mode is released at the start.

[previewyoutube=GX4UKqasr2A;full][/previewyoutube]

The development team is working hard on a major update with additional storylines.
We are also working hard to make the levels with special clear conditions more unique and fun.
We will be taking your valuable feedback into consideration as we work hard to make the game even more enjoyable for everyone!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191770/

notes.title: Development roadmap released!
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying the Gregory Horror Show Soul of Roses!
We will release a development roadmap up to a major update, which we plan to do within six months or so.
Further updates to the full version after that are planned within a year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066317/4346cf53e640109eb6a1002e8619df8797188ff0.png[/img]

We are currently working on the following items.
- Adjustment of level difficulty
- Adjustment of the boss's behavior so that all soul styles can fight fairly to some extent.
- Improving the usability of melee attack soul styles
- Balance adjustment to allow skill-oriented builds by increasing the damage dealt by skills.
- Balance adjustment of underpowered elemental bugs such as wind and darkness
- Addition of levels for special clear conditions outside of normal combat.

In addition, we will be simultaneously working on the renovation of the environmental graphics.
First, we plan to improve the quality of the graveyard stage by enhancing the backgrounds and adding small items that can be destroyed.

We really appreciate your enthusiastic participation in the community.
We will continue to take your feedback and brush up the game to make it even better.

notes.title: Beta Test Review
notes.content:
Thank you for participating in the closed beta test.
It was very encouraging to receive so many positive feedbacks.
We will reflect your feedback in our work and brush up to make it even better.
Below is a summary of areas for improvement based on your feedback.

- Game operability
We will add tutorials for controls that were not explained, such as double jumps, descending from the floor, and dash avoidance.
We will also add explanations of other controls in general.

- Difficulty of the game
We have received a variety of opinions ranging from those who said the game is too difficult to those who want a higher difficulty mode.
Our policy for the future is to make the effects of the assist mode easier to understand and adjust it so that people who are not used to playing action games can play more comfortably.
We do not plan to implement the high difficulty mode at the start of Early Access, but will implement it in a major update or when the product version is released.
In addition, because enemy HP was too high overall, we will reduce the HP and density of enemies and instead respond by increasing their attack and mobility to enhance the speed of the game.
Stage gimmicks will be added and the stage structure and enemy placement will be refined.
We will implement a mid-boss, which was not implemented in the beta test.
We are also planning to add distinctive memories that will make you want to use more different soul styles.

- About the game's ease of understanding
Many players said, “The game is fun once you understand the gameplay, but the first few rounds were hard until you understand it.
We will improve the game by adding a mechanism to help players understand the gameplay in the early stages of the game, and by displaying an explanation of the new soul style when it is transformed into a new one, so that players will find the game interesting more quickly.
Also, various effects and sound effects will be added so that the game will not become monotonous and you will know that you are making progress. (e.g., progress indicator to the boss, Soul Resonance completion, memory acquisition, etc.)

- Graphics
The icons of memory will be redesigned to have a more unified design within the overall game.

- Glitches
We have received many reports of problems with game progression, graphic clutter, mistranslations, etc. We are very grateful for all of the help we have received.
All reported bugs will be fixed.


We will release the demo version on Steam after we have completed all the measures based on the feedback from the beta test.
The demo version will be basically the same as the beta test version, but with additional restrictions on character conversations, gift conversations, soul taker enhancements, etc.
The demo version will have no restrictions on live video or SNS posting.
After the release of the demo version, we plan to participate in SteamNextFes in mid-October and launch the Early Access version in early November after the completion of SteamNextFes.
The Early Access version will include the main storyline that was not implemented in the beta test and demo versions.

We apologize for the delay from our original release plan, but we will deliver the game to you with even better quality.
Please look forward to it.

notes.title: "Gregory Horror Show Soul of Roses" Steam page is now available!
notes.content:
We at Unframe are a game development studio made up of a group of highly creative individuals.
"Soul of Roses" will be a 2D rogue light action game planned and developed by Unframe with Gregory Horror Show author Iwata Naomi as the illustrator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066317/f2fa0d34925b951b8722fe533c7d5c4611d86332.png[/img]

This title features a soul style system that allows players to change their fighting style by absorbing and transforming the abilities of their enemies.
There are many unique "soul styles" to choose from, so you will surely find your favorite fighting style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066317/576699ffa9adc944856e4c155800b86963ad07df.gif[/img]

At the home, you can enjoy conversations with the habitual residents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066317/466149d2d7d5f3d32caddddd1926f25b0365cb46.jpg[/img]

We are working hard to welcome you to the world of Gregory Horror Show!
Please be sure to add us to your wish list to receive updates!
